name: AM-GUI: beta-1.85
body:
## What's Changed

- Fix install progress parsing and restore hourglass ETA UX by @Shikakiben in https://github.com/Shikakiben/AM-GUI/pull/66
- Improvements by @fiftydinar:
  - Don't run update if `am`/`appman` background update process is already running in the background (avoids conflicts and it's useful for distros which have automatic `am` updates through cron/systemd timer)
  - Warn user if both `am` and `appman` is installed and tell him how to fix that
  - Improve reliability and loading speed of "Applications" and "Installed" data
  - Add info toast if no apps in category are available
  - minor bug fixes
